title: Datasets for Fairness in Language Models: An In-Depth Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing fairness datasets by calculating representativeness bias (KL divergence against census data), annotation bias (analyzing gaps in sentiment, toxicity, regard, and gender polarity using automated scorers), and stereotype leakage (PMI/MI co-occurrence analysis).

Evaluating datasets for representational skew against population priors, and measuring annotation bias and stereotype leakage by analyzing toxicity, sentiment, and lexical co-occurrences for different racial and ethnic groups.

Measuring demographic representativeness and evaluating annotation bias (e.g., disparities in Perspective API toxicity and RoBERTa regard scores) and stereotype leakage across various religious identities.

Assessing representativeness against demographic statistics and measuring annotation bias by analyzing toxicity and sentiment score disparities for age-related terms across datasets like BBQ and BOLD.
Calculating representativeness bias and evaluating annotation bias through automated toxicity and sentiment scoring for queer versus non-queer identities in datasets like HONEST, RedditBias, and BBQ.
Evaluating dataset representativeness and measuring annotation bias using automated scoring tools (e.g., VADER sentiment shifts) across socioeconomic and class categories.
Assessing representativeness against census data and measuring annotation bias through toxicity and sentiment score gaps for disability-related terms in datasets like CrowS-Pairs and BBQ.
Analyzing representativeness and measuring annotation bias via toxicity and regard score disparities for different nationalities in datasets like HolisticBias and BBQ.
Evaluating representativeness and calculating annotation bias (e.g., toxicity and insult score gaps) for appearance and weight-related terms in datasets like CrowS-Pairs and HolisticBias.
Measuring annotation bias by analyzing sentiment, toxicity, and regard scores across different political ideologies using the BOLD dataset.
